sentences.en: Cheese and other dairy products do not agree with me.
sentences.zh: 奶酪和其他乳制品对我来说不太适合。

sentences.en: Cheese, butter, cream, yogurt and kefir are dairy products.
sentences.zh: 奶酪、黄油、奶油、酸奶和开菲尔都是乳制品。

sentences.en: How many men do you have working in the dairy now?
sentences.zh: 你现在有多少工人在奶牛场工作？

senses.zh: 乳制的；乳品业的；牛奶的
